title: Cultural impacts on memory and their applications in legal, clinical and political settings
titleZh: 文化对记忆的影响及其在法律、临床和政治情境中的应用
abstract: Nature Reviews Psychology, Published online: 09 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s44159-026-00637-z Memory construction is inextricable from culture and has critical consequences for one’s identity, actions and mental health. In this Review, Wang et al. synthesize the intersections between culture and memory, focusing on memory for specific events and highlighting legal, clinical and political settings.
